name: entropy_regime_v1
mechanism: When institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithms are actively working large directional NIFTY orders, the 5-second return distribution compresses into a tight cluster of small positive (buy program) or small negative (sell program) values — Shannon entropy over the preceding 60 bars (5 minutes) falls below 1.8 bits versus the random-walk baseline of 3.0 bits (log2(8) for 8 bins). This compressed entropy signals an order program with 40-60% unfilled lots remaining, which creates 30-90 second autocorrelation in NIFTY spot returns as the algorithm continues filling. We enter in the direction of the dominant 5-second mean return with VWAP and EMA confirmation, and exit within 90 seconds before the program completes and entropy reverts toward baseline.
core_signal_oneliner: Shannon entropy of 5s returns over 60 bars falls below 1.8 bits, signaling an active institutional order program; entry direction from dominant mean return
